question: Who won Breakthrough of the Year at the 2025 Laureus Awards?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lamine Yamal**__.

• **Lamine Yamal**, the Spanish professional footballer, was honored with the **Breakthrough of the Year** award at the **2025 Laureus World Sports Awards**.
 
• The **17-year-old** **FC Barcelona** winger gained global recognition for his extraordinary performance during the **2024 calendar year**, particularly at the **UEFA Euro 2024**.
 
• He played a crucial role in helping **Spain** secure the **European Championship** title, where he was also named the **Young Player of the Tournament**.
 
• The **Laureus World Breakthrough of the Year** award specifically recognizes individuals or teams who have made a significant "breakthrough" in the sporting world, marking a transition to elite status.
